intent: Record as reviewed the envelope, batch, retention, paging, evidence and summary rules the trace Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context trace lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: evaluation_started and evaluation_completed events are refused unless the orchestrator emitted them, even from an otherwise known producer.
An event's seq must be from 1 to 100000; a larger seq is refused.
An event's attempt must be from 1 to 100000; a larger attempt is refused.
An event whose status is not one of the known outcomes is refused.
An event is accepted only under a 1.x schema version; another major version is refused while additive minor versions are accepted.
An event whose emitted_by is not a known producer is refused.
A trace is not complete when the run started but no sandbox stream exists; a run that never started is not flagged.
An invalid event is counted as rejected and skipped; the other events in the same batch are still stored.
Trace maintenance deletes events older than the first day of the month holding the retention cutoff; events of that month stay.
Trace partition maintenance without a positive retention window is refused and deletes no events.
The advanced trace returns at most 1000 events per page, says more remain, and gives a cursor that continues after the last one.
The evidence an evaluation reads holds at most the last 500 events and is marked truncated and incomplete when more exist.
The general trace lists at most the first 100 skills used while still counting all of them.
The general trace lists at most the first 100 errors while still counting all of them.
Reported usage takes a readable run_total figure field by field and otherwise sums the per-call figures.
A tool call counts as a success only when its outcome is succeeded.
Events that occurred at the same instant are ordered by producer, then attempt, then seq.
A trace cursor that is negative or not a number answers 400 in every view.
